title: img2img-studio editor manifest (version 1)
description: Machine-readable manifest emitted by the dsh-img2img-config image editor as img2img-manifest.json. version = 1. Consumers must tolerate and ignore unknown properties so later versions can add fields.

version.description: Manifest format version. Refuse or degrade explicitly on unknown versions.

mode.description: How the source bitmap reached the target size.

changed.description: Whether the user changed the size at all.

requested.description: The user asked to remove the background.

localPreview.description: The local flood-fill preview was applied to the exported base.

strokes.description: Number of brush strokes; mask file exists only when > 0.

prompt.description: What should happen inside the brushed area.

markers.description: Numbered change markers. x/y are normalized 0-1 with the top-left corner at (0,0).

text.description: What to change at this position.

files.description: File names staged beside the manifest in the composer; resolve them relative to the manifest.

edited.description: Clean base image (resize and cutout applied, no pins).

marked.description: Base image with numbered pins (marker guidance only; never the generation base).

mask.description: Brush mask PNG: white = rework, black = keep; same size as edited.
